name: Teleclod
where_agents_run: your machine (or another computer or Docker/VPS you own); phone or browser controls it through its cloud relay
license: Closed source; Free plan, Pro $29/month ($24 billed yearly), $5/month per extra machine
source_note: Checked against teleclod.com llms.txt and llms-full.txt, the homepage and FAQ text in its site bundle, its public release feed (/api/releases/all) and four blog posts. No public repo, no independent reviews found. Not installed or run here.

harness_count.value: 4 CLI agents, plus 10+ API providers and Ollama

needs_you_signal.value: Waiting-on-you status; desktop and phone notifications

approve_deny_prompt.value: Approve plans, answer questions; no per-command allow
